ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows organisms including Seeds, Grouse, Goshawk, Chipmunk, Berries, Grasshopper, Grasses, Marmot, Elk, and Grizzly bear. The Chipmunk is near the center. Arrows from the Chipmunk area connect to predators including the Goshawk and the Grizzly bear. The Grizzly bear also has other incoming food links shown, while the Goshawk appears to have Chipmunk as its main shown prey in this diagram. Reasoning: If chipmunks disappeared, the animals that eat chipmunks would lose a food source. Both the Goshawk and Grizzly bear could be affected, but the Grizzly bear has other food sources in the web. The Goshawk has fewer alternative food sources shown, so it would be affected most by the disappearance of chipmunks.
